sloka: स्वम् स्वम् निलयम् आगम्य पुत्र दारैः समावृताः ।अश्रूणि मुमुचुः सर्वे बाष्पेण पिहित आननाः ॥२-४८-३॥
transliteration: svam svam nilayam āgamya putra dāraiḥ samāvṛtāḥ ।aśrūṇi mumucuḥ sarve bāṣpeṇa pihita ānanāḥ ॥2-48-3॥

translations.english: The subjects reached their respective homes and surrounded by their sons and wives broke down their faces flooded with tears.
